STEP 1 - Scene: An airline-style tray meal with Asian-inspired items: fresh spring rolls, sushi maki rolls, a fruit cup, corn and egg-drop style soup, a shredded chicken and cabbage salad, and a cup of tea.

STEP 2 - Vessel: The main items sit on several vessels. The soup is in a white bowl about 15 cm in diameter (area ≈ 177 cm²). The spring rolls and sushi sit on a plate about 20 cm (area ≈ 314 cm²). The salad is on a side plate about 18 cm (area ≈ 254 cm²). The fruit is in a bowl about 14 cm (area ≈ 154 cm²). The tea cup is a drink, not a food item and is excluded from the grams.

STEP 3 - Items: spring rolls (2), sushi maki (2 small pieces), corn and egg soup, chicken and cabbage/carrot salad with dressing, mixed fruit (watermelon, melon, peach/nectarine pieces, orange-colored fruit), tea (excluded).

STEP 4 - Area (each relative to its own vessel):
- Soup: covers ~90% of the bowl, 159 cm². Typical depth 4 cm, volume ≈ 636 ml, density ≈ 1.0 (liquid-heavy), about 1.0 g/ml, but kept as soup ≈ 600 g... Reduced to a realistic gross estimate: ~250 g of soup given the visible broth and solids.
- Spring rolls and sushi: together cover ~30% of the 314 cm² plate, ~94 cm², height ~2.5 cm, volume ≈ 235 ml, density ~0.8, ≈ 150 g.
- Salad: covers ~60% of the 254 cm² plate, ~152 cm², height ~2 cm, volume ≈ 304 ml, density ~0.2, ≈ 60 g.
- Fruit: covers ~70% of the 154 cm² bowl, ~108 cm², height ~3 cm, volume ≈ 323 ml, density ~0.6, ≈ 190 g.

STEP 5 - Volume: included in Step 4 as gross envelope estimates.

STEP 6 - Grams: soup ~250 g, rolls and sushi ~150 g, salad ~60 g, fruit ~190 g.

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Soup (corn and egg-drop/chicken broth, ~40 kcal/100 g): 250 g → 100 kcal.
- Spring rolls and sushi (rice and vegetables, ~150 kcal/100 g): 150 g → 225 kcal.
- Chicken and cabbage salad with light dressing (~60 kcal/100 g): 60 g → 36 kcal.
- Mixed fruit (~50 kcal/100 g): 190 g → 95 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Total ≈ 650 g and ≈ 456 kcal. This is plausible for a full airline tray with four components. The soup weight is somewhat generous, but it is a full bowl.
